mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_trn_attendance_request ( attendance_request_id, attendance_id, requested_working_start_time, requested_working_end_time, request_reason, request_flag, request_type ) VALUES ( #{attendanceRequestId}, #{attendanceId}, #{workingStartTime}, #{workingEndTime}, #{requestReason}, #{requestFlag}, #{requestType} )
mapper.select: SELECT request.attendance_id AS attendanceId, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE request.request_flag = 1 ) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE request.request_flag = 2 ) > 0 THEN 2 END AS requestFlag FROM tb_trn_attendance_request request INNER JOIN tb_trn_attendance attendance ON request.attendance_id = attendance.attendance_id WHERE attendance.user_id = #{employeeId} AND attendance.working_day BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND request.request_flag IN (1, 2) GROUP BY request.attendance_id

SELECT request.attendance_request_id AS attendanceRequestId, request.attendance_id AS attendanceId, request.requested_working_start_time AS workingStartTime, request.requested_working_end_time AS workingEndTime, request.request_flag AS requestFlag, request.request_type AS requestType FROM tb_trn_attendance_request request INNER JOIN tb_trn_attendance attendance ON request.attendance_id = attendance.attendance_id WHERE attendance.user_id = #{employeeId} AND attendance.working_day = #{workingDay} AND request.request_flag IN (1, 2) ORDER BY request.attendance_request_id

SELECT request.attendance_request_id AS attendanceRequestId, request.attendance_id AS attendanceId, request.requested_working_start_time AS workingStartTime, request.requested_working_end_time AS workingEndTime, request.request_flag AS requestFlag, request.request_type AS requestType FROM tb_trn_attendance_request request INNER JOIN tb_trn_attendance attendance ON request.attendance_id = attendance.attendance_id WHERE attendance.user_id = #{employeeId} AND attendance.working_day BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND request.request_flag = 1 ORDER BY attendance.working_day ASC, request.attendance_request_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_trn_attendance_request request SET request_flag = 3 WHERE request.attendance_request_id = #{requestId} AND request.request_flag = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_trn_attendance attendance WHERE attendance.attendance_id = request.attendance_id AND attendance.user_id = #{employeeId} )
